description: Curated BMS hardening overrides. Generic derivation fills the rest.

REQ-BMS-001.rationale: BMS software architecture allocation. The source CSV has no system/stakeholder hierarchy; a placeholder parent REQ-BMS-000 is injected for traceability.
open_issues: Placeholder system parent REQ-BMS-000; confirm the stakeholder/system requirement and ASIL allocation with the BMS owner.

REQ-BMS-002.statement: RE_EstimateSOC shall execute cyclically every 10 ms and compute the battery State-of-Charge using the specified SOC estimation method, writing the result to PP_SOCPercent.
REQ-BMS-002.rationale: The source mandates a 10 ms SOC runnable and an EKF-based estimator. The helper-function names are design details and are recorded in design_notes.
REQ-BMS-002.design_notes: EKF_Predict(), EKF_Update(), SOC_Clamp() are implementation helpers; the equivalent-circuit model and noise values are design/calibration details.
open_issues: Confirm the SOC estimation algorithm, equivalent-circuit parameters and validation tolerance with the BMS algorithm owner.

REQ-BMS-003.statement: RE_BalanceCells shall execute cyclically every 100 ms to compare individual cell voltages and activate passive bleed resistors on cells above the mean.
REQ-BMS-003.rationale: The source defines a 100 ms balancing runnable; helper names are design details.
REQ-BMS-003.design_notes: CalcCellDelta(), SelectBalanceCells(), SetBalanceRelays() are implementation helpers.

REQ-BMS-004.statement: RE_ManageThermal shall execute cyclically every 50 ms to compute the battery temperature gradient, control the cooling pump PWM duty cycle, and apply power derating when thermal limits are approached.
REQ-BMS-004.rationale: The source defines a 50 ms thermal-management runnable. Helper names are design details.
REQ-BMS-004.design_notes: CalcTempGradient() and SetCoolingPWM() are implementation helpers.

REQ-BMS-005.statement: RE_MonitorSafety shall execute cyclically every 5 ms to perform overcurrent, overvoltage, undervoltage, and overtemperature plausibility checks and set the corresponding DTC within the same 5 ms execution when a fault is detected.
REQ-BMS-005.rationale: The source requires a 5 ms safety monitor and same-cycle fault reporting. OpenContactors() is the fault reaction, specified separately.
REQ-BMS-005.design_notes: OpenContactors() is invoked by the fault reaction; the safety monitor owns detection and DTC reporting.

REQ-BMS-006.statement: RE_ControlContactors shall execute on a DataReceivedEvent of VehicleReadyStatus to manage the precharge and main-contactor sequence (OPEN, PRECHARGE, MAIN_CLOSE) and verify the contactor state after each transition.
REQ-BMS-006.rationale: The source defines the contactor sequence and state verification. Helper names are design details.

REQ-BMS-007.statement: RE_Initialize shall execute once on ECU startup to read the last known SOC from NVM, perform a cell voltage scan, validate sensor signals, and set the SWC state to INIT only after RAM CRC and ROM CRC-32 self-tests complete.
REQ-BMS-007.rationale: Startup initialization including NVM read, sensor validation and self-tests. The source uses NvM_ReadBlock; the block name is a design detail.
REQ-BMS-007.design_notes: NvM_ReadBlock(NvM_BMS_SOCLog) is the NVM access detail.

REQ-BMS-010.rationale: Required-port declaration. The source bundles five ports in one requirement; the data dictionary must confirm each interface.
open_issues: Interface requirement bundles five ports; split into per-port requirements in the next revision and confirm ranges/resolutions against the DDS.

REQ-BMS-011.rationale: Provided-port declaration. The source bundles five ports in one requirement; the data dictionary must confirm each interface.
open_issues: Interface requirement bundles five ports; split into per-port requirements in the next revision and confirm ranges/resolutions against the DDS.

REQ-BMS-020.statement: EKF_Predict() shall propagate the state vector [SOC, V_RC1, V_RC2] forward using the specified equivalent-circuit model and calibrated parameters.
REQ-BMS-020.constraint_rationale: The EKF state-propagation equation is retained as a deterministic algorithm/calibration constraint; the exact equation is a design detail recorded in design_notes.
REQ-BMS-020.design_notes: SOC(k+1) = SOC(k) - (I_pack * DT) / Q_nom; V_RC1/2 update with exp(-DT/tau); DT = 0.01 s; parameters from calibration.

REQ-BMS-021.statement: EKF_Update() shall compute the Kalman gain and correct the state estimate using the measured pack voltage and the specified equivalent-circuit model.
REQ-BMS-021.constraint_rationale: The Kalman-gain and covariance update are retained as a deterministic algorithm/calibration constraint; the exact equations are design details recorded in design_notes.
REQ-BMS-021.design_notes: K = P_pred H^T / (H P_pred H^T + R); x_est = x_pred + K(V_meas - V_model); P_est = (I - K H) P_pred; R = 1e-4 V^2; Q_SOC = 1e-8.

REQ-BMS-022.rationale: SOC clamping protects the usable window and triggers a DTC when the raw estimate leaves 5-95% for 10 consecutive cycles.

REQ-BMS-023.rationale: Coulomb-counting fallback when the voltage measurement is unavailable; the 2% SOC/hour error is the source's stated accuracy target.

REQ-BMS-031.rationale: Limits simultaneous bleed resistors to 8 to bound heat generation and selects the highest-delta cells when more than 8 are candidates.

REQ-BMS-032.rationale: Balancing is inhibited above 5 A pack current to prevent measurement interference; the 1 ms SPI write is a timing constraint.

REQ-BMS-041.constraint_rationale: The PI cooling-control equation is a deterministic calibration/implementation constraint; the gains and target temperature are calibration values.
REQ-BMS-041.design_notes: duty = K_COOL_P*(T_max - T_TARGET_K) + K_COOL_I*integral; T_TARGET_K = 298.15 K; K_COOL_P = 5.0 %/K; K_COOL_I = 0.1 %/(K*s); clamp 0-100%.

REQ-BMS-042.constraint_rationale: The derating equation is a deterministic calibration/implementation constraint; the start temperature and range are calibration values.
REQ-BMS-042.design_notes: derate = 1 - clamp((T_max - 313.15 K)/20 K, 0, 1); P_MAX_W = 150 kW.

REQ-BMS-050.rationale: Overcurrent protection thresholds are 300 A discharge and -150 A charge with a 10 ms debounce. These are narrower than the port range of +/-500 A and must be reconciled with the fuse and sensor range.
open_issues: Reconcile I_MAX_DISCHARGE = 300 A / I_MAX_CHARGE = -150 A with the RP_PackCurrent range +/-500 A and the 500 A fuse; confirm the protection hierarchy.

REQ-BMS-051.rationale: Cell over/undervoltage protection at 4.20 V / 2.50 V with a two-cycle debounce.

REQ-BMS-052.rationale: Overtemperature protection at 60 C with a 20 ms debounce; recovery is intentionally manual for a thermal event.

REQ-BMS-053.statement: OpenContactors() shall set PP_ContactorState = OPEN, zero the discharge and charge power limits, report the triggering DTC to DEM, and persist the fault record to NVM within the 5 ms RE_MonitorSafety window.
REQ-BMS-053.rationale: The source defines a four-step fault reaction within the 5 ms safety-monitor window. NVM persistence inside 5 ms may require a deferred-write mechanism.
open_issues: Confirm whether NVM persistence can complete within 5 ms or whether a deferred/queued write is required; the timing budget must be verified.

REQ-BMS-060.rationale: Precharge sequence with a 2 s timeout and abort-to-OPEN behaviour.

REQ-BMS-061.rationale: Contactor feedback mismatch for more than 50 ms is treated as a weld fault and drives FAIL_SAFE.

REQ-BMS-070.statement: RE_EstimateSOC shall update State-of-Health after each charge from 10 % SOC to 90 % SOC by computing Q_meas = integral(I_pack * DT) over that window and setting SOH = (Q_meas / Q_nom_new) * 100 %, where Q_nom_new = 100 Ah.
REQ-BMS-070.rationale: SOH is updated per defined 10-90% SOC charge window; the charge-window definition must be confirmed.
REQ-BMS-070.design_notes: Q_meas = integral(I_pack*DT) over the 10-90% SOC window; Q_nom_new = 100 Ah.
open_issues: Confirm the 10-90% SOC charge window, the 100 Ah rated capacity and the SOH accuracy target.

REQ-BMS-081.rationale: Healable DTCs clear after 5 fault-free cycles; the overtemperature latch is intentionally excluded.

REQ-BMS-090.rationale: E2E Profile 2 protection on safety-relevant CAN inputs; a counter mismatch triggers a CAN-timeout DTC after 3 consecutive failures.

REQ-BMS-091.rationale: Hardware watchdog trigger every 5 ms; a missed trigger resets the ECU and the reset cause is persisted as a DTC.

REQ-BMS-080.statement: DTC_BMS_SOC_LIMIT (0xB10003) shall be reported via Dem_ReportErrorStatus when the raw SOC estimate exceeds SOC_MAX = 95 % or falls below SOC_MIN = 5 % for 10 consecutive 10 ms cycles.
REQ-BMS-080.rationale: SOC-limit DTC reporting with snapshot data.
open_issues: Confirm the snapshot data set and the 10-cycle debounce.
